description: Fresh read-only review of e34d5607 after empty-snapshot and constant-memory validation fixes. Verify correctness, tests, and regression risks before PR.

comments.text: Cold review of e34d5607: BLOCKER remains. High — lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/index.ex:192-205 does not fail closed for invalid incremental version history. A durable empty block v20 whose nonzero predecessor v10 is absent hits load_page_block :not_found, is downgraded to Version.zero, synthesizes page 0, and recovers successfully as an empty index at v20. This can silently hide all prior data behind an empty eviction block. A two-record v10->v20, v20->v10 predecessor cycle also loops forever because traversal tracks neither visited versions nor monotonic descent. Valid fresh empty history v20->zero and snapshots terminating at nil do not require the fallback. Return a structured error for a missing nonzero target and reject repeated/non-descending predecessor versions; add regressions for valid empty->zero, missing nonzero predecessor, and a cycle. Medium — index.ex:286-315 validates chain membership by map keys but never checks each map key equals Page.id(page). A complete snapshot %{0 => {Page.new(1, [{"a", locator}]), 0}} passes recovery; Tree.from_page_map indexes page 1, then locator_for_key raises because page_map only has key 0. Validate embedded page identity before building the tree. Positive results: right-edge routing is correct; complete empty snapshots now reject; global order/adjacent duplicate/reachability validation is constant-key-memory and sound for the GH #158 corruption shape; error propagation, recovered data offset, and analyzer clauses look correct. Verification: full Olivine suite 312 tests + 23 properties passed; focused routing/recovery/snapshot suites passed; mix format --check-formatted, git diff --check, and mix credo --strict passed.
